_note: Custom descriptions for system tools (plan L208: language_detection with a custom description; risk 2 at L234). WP8/provisioning copies them into the agent config.
language_detection: Switch the conversation between Russian (ru), the default, and Latvian (lv), which is equal. Call it ONLY when the caller speaks a complete sentence in the other language, including in reply to the opening, or explicitly asks to switch (e.g. 'Runāsim latviski', 'Можно по-русски?'). Call it BEFORE your first word in the new language, in both directions; going back to Russian after Latvian also needs this call with ru, even though Russian is the default. Never answer in another language without this call. Russian written in Latin letters (e.g. 'zdravstvujte', 'mozhno po-russki') counts as Russian. Do NOT call it for Latvian street, district or company names inside Russian speech (e.g. 'Ilūkstes iela шестнадцать', 'Rīgas namu pārvaldnieks'), for single words such as 'labi', 'paldies', 'да', for numbers, or for an address dictated in Latvian form. If unsure, stay in the current language.
end_call: End the call after the caller has said goodbye and you have said the closing line, or after a booking or callback is confirmed and the caller has nothing more to ask.
skip_turn: Stay silent and wait. Use ONLY in two cases: (a) a «...» turn when your previous reply was the check-in «Алло, вы меня слышите?» (LV «Hallo, vai jūs mani dzirdat?»); (b) a message with no words at all, only hesitation sounds («Э-э-э...», «М-м-м...», «Хм...»). Any message with words gets an answer, or a short re-ask if it is unclear («Извините, не расслышала. Повторите, пожалуйста?»); never use this tool for it, nor for noise words or background talk. The first «...» after any other reply of yours, including your greeting, gets «Алло, вы меня слышите?» instead.
